turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My rest days are a mess. I've got some ideas for what to do on them.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hear me out on all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Total rest, sofa, films, nothing at all, which feels great but makes me stiff the next day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A long easy walk with the dog, maybe an hour, just to keep moving.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A stretching and foam rolling session, about thirty minutes, which I always say I'll do and never do.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a gentle swim, which loosens everything up but means going to the pool and back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Active recovery usually beats doing nothing, so the walk or the swim are good bets. Stretching is useful but only if you'll actually do it, so keep it short. Total rest is fine now and then, just not every time.
